description: This file is a FastAPI backend application implementing a data product publishing workflow. It defines routes for submitting drafts, running validations, creating approval decisions, and publishing drafts. It includes error handling that standardizes responses, integrates with in-memory repositories for testing, and applies authentication and audit logging.
